products.product_description: Brunkow Cheese of Wisconsin, Monterey Jack Morel Mushroom & Onion Cheese, 5 lb block plastic wrapped and vacuum sealed. Eight blocks per case. Ingredients: Cultured Pasteurized Whole Milk, Salt, Microbial Enzymes, Morel Mushroom and Onion.
products.reason_for_recall: Brunkow Cheese of Wisconsin is recalling Monterey Jack Morel Mushroom Cheese because the product is mislabeled. The product contains other type of mushroom instead of Morel Mushrooms as listed on the label.
